summary: get_courses accesses service.db.query(service.repo.model).all() directly; CourseService has .repo (BaseRepository with .model=Course) so syntax valid, but bypasses service layer and exposes all courses with no pagination.
failure_scenario: Any call to /courses/ loads entire table; large dataset causes slow response / memory pressure; no auth/filter applied at endpoint level.

summary: Regex changed to Nota(?:tion|te) with optional colon (:?) ; matches Notation/Notate but excludes Note/Nota solo; :? allows missing colon so 'Concept foo' matches unexpectedly.
failure_scenario: Input 'Note: definition' fails to match (should match if 'Note' intended); input 'Concept foo' matches without colon (loose).

summary: except: replaced with pass, removing the fallback string-parse for metadata; dead parse code at 105-109 unreachable after continue.
failure_scenario: Source metadata in 'semester:1,subject:X' format no longer parsed; meta stays empty -> subject_name='Unknown Subject'; skip guard at 99 may incorrectly skip if meta has empty string text.

summary: Meta validation guard if not meta.get('text') and not meta.get('structured') treats falsy values (0, '', []) as missing; skips valid empty-text or structured-empty cases.
failure_scenario: meta={'text':''} or meta={'structured':[]} incorrectly skipped with 'extraction produced no structured/text output'.

summary: dnaData?.sample_size?.time_range_years?.join(' - ') calls .join() on tuple[int,int]; tuples have no .join method.
failure_scenario: Loading DNA data with time_range_years=(2015,2024) throws TypeError: tuple object has no attribute 'join'; page crashes.

summary: line-clamp-3 Tailwind class used; not in default Tailwind config without @plugin/@line-clamp plugin; may not truncate.
failure_scenario: Family name text overflows container; no truncation rendered if tailwind plugin missing.

summary: extract_structured static method calls PDFParser.extract_text_with_pages(file_stream); file_stream is consumed by pdfplumber.open without seek(0) reset, so second call or reuse fails.
failure_scenario: Calling extract_structured twice on same stream; or calling extract_text_with_pages after extract_structured raises pdfplumber error because stream at EOF.

summary: Backtester serializes e.exam_type but Exam model defines term (not exam_type); mapping wrong field name.
failure_scenario: Exam objects have .term; .exam_type is None/AttributeError -> hist_exams_dicts contain exam_type=None, breaking downstream DNA analysis that expects exam_type.
